title: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning
paper_type_zh: 前沿形式化推理技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要区分 Lean 整证明终态验证、自动形式化语义审查与交互式步骤反馈，并审计 RL 复现边界的读者
one_line: Kimina-Prover discloses a 200K Lean prompt construction, about 20K cold starts, whole-proof compiler-terminal RL, and public distills/tooling, but not core prompts, rollouts, rewards, environment pins, or full lineage.
Kimina-Prover 披露了 20 万条 Lean prompt 构建、约 2 万条冷启动轨迹、整证明的 Lean 编译终态 RL，以及公开的蒸馏模型/工具；但未公开核心 prompt、rollout、奖励、环境版本锁定或完整谱系。
why: It distinguishes whole-proof terminal programmatic feedback from imperfect LLM/human-reviewed autoformalization and from interactive step feedback, showing why released artifacts do not reproduce the full pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Moonshot/Numina formal-reasoning report with concrete Lean terminal RL, autoformalization validation, SFT/distillation, limited public artifacts, and material reproducibility boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Kimina-Prover Preview addresses large-scale formal mathematical reasoning in Lean4. Its pipeline turns informal competition-style mathematics into Lean statements and trains a proof policy with reinforcement learning (RL). For this atlas, the important question is exactly what Lean compilation verifies and what it does not.

A proof that compiles establishes that a submitted Lean term is accepted for the supplied formal theorem in the configured environment. It does not establish that an automatically formalized Lean theorem preserves the intended informal mathematics. It also does not provide interactive correctness feedback for intermediate proof steps while the model is generating a proof.

Kimina-Prover Preview 面向 Lean4 中的大规模形式化数学推理。其管线将非形式化的竞赛数学转换为 Lean 陈述，并以强化学习（RL）训练证明策略。对于本图谱，关键问题是 Lean 编译究竟验证什么，以及它不验证什么。

能够编译的证明表明：提交的 Lean 项在给定形式化定理和配置环境中被接受。它并不能证明自动形式化的 Lean 定理保留了原始非形式化数学的语义，也不会在模型生成证明的过程中为中间证明步骤提供交互式正确性反馈。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report describes a formal-reasoning recipe with approximately 200K Lean prompts, around 20K Claude 3.7 Sonnet cold starts, Kimi k1.5 informal thinking, a Qwen2.5-72B RL policy, Lean compiler terminal reward, and public 1.5B/7B distills. It combines autoformalized and human-annotated statement paths before proof generation.

The feedback contract has two distinct layers. During proof RL, a completed whole proof receives a binary reward when it compiles in Lean; this is answer-level, full-episode terminal feedback. During autoformalization construction, compilation is combined with QwQ-32B unanimous semantic judging, Lean4 expert monitoring, and contradiction, negation, and triviality filters. Neither layer should be equated with interactive step-by-step prover feedback, and compilation alone does not guarantee semantic correctness of the formalized statement.

报告描述了一套形式化推理配方：约 20 万条 Lean prompt、约 2 万条 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 冷启动、Kimi k1.5 非形式化思考、Qwen2.5-72B RL 策略、Lean 编译器终态奖励，以及公开的 1.5B/7B 蒸馏模型。在证明生成之前，它结合了自动形式化和人工标注的陈述路径。

反馈契约有两个不同层次。证明 RL 中，完成的整份证明只要在 Lean 中编译，就获得二值奖励；这是答案级、完整 episode 的终态反馈。自动形式化构建中，编译还会结合 QwQ-32B 一致性语义判断、Lean4 专家监督以及矛盾、否定和琐碎性过滤。两层都不应被等同于交互式逐步 prover 反馈，而仅凭编译也不能保证形式化陈述的语义正确性。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report starts from filtered NuminaMath 1.5 competition problems that are autoformalized into Lean4, plus human-annotated statements. It describes about 100K autoformalized statements and 10K annotated statements resampled to a 200K-prompt pool. Claude 3.7 Sonnet creates approximately 20K informal/formal cold-start traces, Kimi k1.5 supplies informal thinking, and experts author or refine selected statements and proofs. Source records and item membership are unavailable.

The final training record contains an informal problem, Lean4 statement, think block with informal reasoning and Lean snippets, and a final Lean4 proof. The paper says RL samples require at least one tactic block and tactic blocks must cover 60 percent of final Lean code. Candidate whole-proof rollouts are drawn in batches of 1,000, but rollout count and decoding settings are unknown. Minimal SFT and an informal-math mixture precede KL-constrained RL based on a Kimi k1.5 pipeline.

The RL terminal predicate is compilation of a completed proof using Numina/Kimina Lean Server and LeanREPL. The report does not release training-server version, mathlib snapshot, imports, execution images, core prompts, rollouts, reward logs, or complete rejection/retention records. Autoformalization filtering is separate: it uses compilation, QwQ-32B unanimous semantic judgment, Lean4 expert monitoring, and contradiction, negation, and triviality filters.

报告从经过筛选并被自动形式化为 Lean4 的 NuminaMath 1.5 竞赛题，以及人工标注陈述出发。它描述了约 10 万条自动形式化陈述和 1 万条标注陈述，并重采样为 20 万条 prompt 池。Claude 3.7 Sonnet 创建约 2 万条非形式化/形式化冷启动轨迹，Kimi k1.5 提供非形式化思考，专家撰写或修订部分陈述和证明。来源记录和单条成员关系不可获得。

最终训练记录包含非形式化问题、Lean4 陈述、含非形式化推理和 Lean 片段的 think block，以及最终 Lean4 证明。论文称 RL 样本必须至少包含一个 tactic block，且 tactic block 应覆盖最终 Lean 代码的 60%。候选整证明 rollout 按 1,000 的 batch 抽取，但 rollout 数和解码设置为 unknown。最小 SFT 和非形式化数学混合先于基于 Kimi k1.5 管线、受 KL 约束的 RL。

RL 的终止条件是在 Numina/Kimina Lean Server 和 LeanREPL 中编译一份完成的证明。报告未发布训练 server 版本、mathlib snapshot、imports、执行镜像、核心 prompt、rollout、奖励日志，或完整的拒绝/保留记录。自动形式化筛选是另一层：它使用编译、QwQ-32B 一致性语义判断、Lean4 专家监督，以及矛盾、否定和琐碎性过滤。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv record identifies Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning (2025). The official MoonshotAI/Kimina-Prover-Preview repository provides project material, tools, proof archives, and a corrected miniF2F artifact. The official Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-7B page provides a public distill.

These official artifacts support the claims that public distills, tooling, proof files, and the corrected miniF2F archive exist. They do not establish a release of the complete 200K prompt pool, Claude cold starts, Kimi-thinking mixture, 72B RL rollouts, reward logs, prompt-to-proof lineage, environment pins, or full train/validation partitions.

The report describes 13-gram decontamination and removal of AMC12/AIME/IMO overlap from NuminaMath against miniF2F. It does not provide overlap lists or residual contamination analysis.

官方 arXiv 记录 将该工作标识为 2025 年的 Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning。官方 MoonshotAI/Kimina-Prover-Preview 仓库 提供项目材料、工具、证明档案和经修正的 miniF2F 工件。官方 Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-7B 页面 提供公开蒸馏模型。

这些官方工件支持“公开蒸馏模型、工具、证明文件和修正后的 miniF2F 档案存在”这一主张；它们不证明完整 20 万条 prompt 池、Claude 冷启动、Kimi-thinking 混合、72B RL rollout、奖励日志、prompt 到证明的谱系、环境版本锁定或完整训练/验证划分已发布。

报告描述了针对 miniF2F 的 13-gram 去污染，以及从 NuminaMath 中移除 AMC12/AIME/IMO 重叠；但没有提供重叠列表或残余污染分析。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For Track 12, the central contribution is the ability to audit a formal-RL report without collapsing three claims into one. First, Lean compilation can supply a strong terminal predicate for a whole proof. Second, an autoformalized statement still needs semantic scrutiny, for which the report uses LLM judgment, expert monitoring, and structural filters. Third, neither of these mechanisms provides the model with interactive step feedback while it writes the proof.

The report also exposes an uncommon amount of pipeline structure—prompt counts, cold starts, model roles, code-coverage filtering, decontamination description, and public distills—while withholding the actual artifacts needed to reproduce it. This makes it a useful disclosure boundary rather than an open training-data release.

对 Track 12 而言，核心贡献在于可以审计一份形式化 RL 报告，而不把三种主张混为一谈。第一，Lean 编译能为整份证明提供强终态条件。第二，自动形式化陈述仍需语义审查，报告为此使用 LLM 判断、专家监督和结构过滤。第三，这两种机制都不会在模型书写证明时提供交互式逐步反馈。

报告还披露了相对罕见的管线结构信息——prompt 数量、冷启动、模型角色、代码覆盖过滤、去污染描述和公开蒸馏模型——但仍未公开复现所需的实际工件。因此它适合作为披露边界记录，而不是开放训练数据发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public release does not contain the core prompt pool, source membership, Claude cold starts, Kimi-thinking mixture, RL rollouts, rewards, accepted/rejected proof records, judge prompts, thresholds, sampling parameters, temperatures, optimizer/KL values, or full retention yields. The reported environment is also insufficiently pinned: Lean, mathlib, imports, server versions, and execution images are incomplete.

Compilation answers whether Lean accepts a completed proof of the supplied formal statement in its environment. It cannot on its own catch a semantic mismatch introduced when informal mathematics is autoformalized. QwQ judging and expert monitoring may also have false positives or false negatives, but detailed error rates are unavailable. Public distills and proof files therefore do not make the training or feedback pipeline fully reproducible.

公开发布不包含核心 prompt 池、来源成员关系、Claude 冷启动、Kimi-thinking 混合、RL rollout、奖励、已接受/拒绝证明记录、judge prompt、阈值、采样参数、温度、optimizer/KL 数值或完整保留率。报告的环境版本锁定也不充分：Lean、mathlib、imports、server 版本和执行镜像均不完整。

编译回答的是：在其环境中，Lean 是否接受给定形式化陈述的一份完成证明。它本身无法捕捉非形式化数学自动形式化时引入的语义错配。QwQ 判断和专家监督也可能有假阳性或假阴性，但详细错误率不可获得。因此，公开蒸馏模型和证明文件并不能使训练或反馈管线完全可复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card when comparing formal-proof RL systems or evaluating claims that a prover-backed reward makes a complete pipeline reliable. It supplies a practical audit checklist: identify whether the reward is whole-proof terminal or interactive; inspect theorem-statement semantics separately from proof compilation; require environment pins; and distinguish public proof artifacts or distills from released training prompts, traces, rewards, and lineage.

The report is useful for conceptual study of SFT, cold starts, long informal reasoning, autoformalization, RL with verifiable outcomes, and distillation. It is not a drop-in release of the full RL data, reward interface, formalization validator, or reproducible Lean environment.

当比较形式化证明 RL 系统，或评估“prover 支撑的奖励使完整管线可靠”这类主张时，可使用本 Card。它提供实用审计清单：识别奖励是整证明终态还是交互式；将定理陈述的语义与证明编译分开审查；要求环境版本锁定；并区分公开证明工件/蒸馏模型与已发布训练 prompt、轨迹、奖励和谱系。

该报告可用于概念层面对 SFT、冷启动、长非形式化推理、自动形式化、带可验证结果的 RL 和蒸馏进行研究。它不是完整 RL 数据、奖励接口、形式化验证器或可复现 Lean 环境的可直接使用发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Whole-proof Lean compilation is a binary terminal predicate after a proof is completed; do not label it as interactive step feedback.
  • Audit autoformalization separately: a theorem can compile and still misrepresent the original informal problem, so compilation, LLM judging, expert monitoring, and structural filters serve different roles.
  • Check reproducibility at the artifact level: public distills, tools, and proof archives do not provide the 200K prompts, RL rollouts, reward logs, source lineage, or fully pinned Lean environment.

• 整证明 Lean 编译是在证明完成后给出的二值终态条件；不要将其标为交互式步骤反馈。
  • 应单独审计自动形式化：一个定理可以编译却仍错误表达原始非形式化问题，因此编译、LLM 判断、专家监督和结构过滤承担不同角色。
  • 应在工件层检查可复现性：公开蒸馏模型、工具和证明档案并未提供 20 万条 prompt、RL rollout、奖励日志、来源谱系或完整锁定的 Lean 环境。
